component.name: FlashGBX
component.summary: Reads and writes Game Boy and Game Boy Advance cartridges

description.p: FlashGBX reads and writes Game Boy, Game Boy Color and Game Boy Advance cartridge data using compatible cartridge reader/writer hardware.

ul.li: Backup, restore and erase save data, including Real Time Clock registers
Backup ROM data from game cartridges
Write new ROMs to a wide variety of flash cartridges
Automatically detect many reproduction and flash cartridges
Query flash chips, including Common Flash Interface information
Decode and extract Game Boy Camera photos from save data
Generate ROM dump reports for game preservation

description.p: Compatible cartridge reader/writer hardware includes GBxCart RW, GBFlash, Joey Jr and Game Bub.
